meta.subject: Social Science
meta.source_edition: Tamil Nadu SCERT original 2019; revised English edition 2020 and 2022
meta.source_review: All 27 Class 10 Social Science titles and English chapter opening pages are indexed from a Tamil Nadu SCERT combined volume revised in 2022. Twenty-two chapters have bilingual 20-question starter quizzes (440 MCQs). New History 6 and Geography 6 chapter themes were cross-checked against accessible Class 10 chapter study materials, but question page references are approximate, not independently verified passage proof. Original Tamil-text proofreading and the currently prescribed 2026–27 edition are not independently certified.
meta.publication_status: All 27 chapters indexed: 22 original bilingual starter banks with 440 MCQs. History 1–6, Geography 1–6, Civics 1–5 and Economics 1–5 are playable. Five chapters remain pending (History 7–10 and Geography 7), with no fabricated playable links.
meta.editorial_status: The 2022 revised English source is verified as a historical source, not certified as the latest prescribed edition; Tamil translation and source pages require independent original-book editorial review.
meta.quality_policy: Ready indicates one original 20-question bilingual four-option starter quiz with keyed answer and bilingual explanation; it does not certify full chapter coverage, 2026–27 prescribed edition, original Tamil phrasing or passage-verified source pages.
